TriCipta AI · Third Joint Development Agreement

JDA3Surface Equipment Optimisation with AI

JDA3 is the Production Phase of TriCipta AI — Petronas Carigali's AI delivery arm for Upstream, built through a strategic partnership with IBM Malaysia and Tridiagonal.ai.

It moves Upstream from reactive surveillance to proactive, system-level AI across three pillars — Production Optimisation, Proactive Physical Asset Management, and Lean Workforce & AI-Driven Operations — deployed across 26 assets over a two-year programme to push Unit Production Cost below USD 6/BOE, cut carbon intensity to 17 kgCO₂e/BOE, and lift delivery attainability from 70% to 90%.

Collaborators

The three organisations behind JDA3, and what each contributes.

Petronas Carigali

Asset owner & primary beneficiary

Gives production & maintenance data, business workflows, and investment to co-develop.

Gets competitive edge through bespoke AI, product exclusivity, and IP — 100% PETRONAS-owned for in-house work, shared IP for co-developed AI.

IBM Malaysia

AI Technology for Lean Workforce & AI-Driven Operations

Leads AI/ML algorithm development, digital infrastructure design, and end-to-end product adoption.

Brings agentic AI, digital twins, scalable cloud/on-prem architecture, real-time optimisation, and Integrated Activity Planning (IAP) workflow transformation.

Tridiagonal.ai

Domain Engineering for Production, Reliability & Maintenance

Provides operational credibility and production/asset-management domain strength.

Contributes Integrated Surface Equipment Modelling and Advanced Time-Series Analytics & Anomaly Detection — the engineering logic that validates every model.

Press release

The official announcement of JDA3.

On 8 July 2026, Petronas Carigali signed the third Joint Development Agreement with IBM Malaysia and Tridiagonal.ai, extending TriCipta AI into Surface Equipment Optimisation with AI.

At the signing, Petronas Carigali CEO Hazli Sham Kassim said the company is "embedding it to drive bottom-line performance, asset reliability, and speed-to-value."

Read the full release on petronas.com →
